sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this anticipatory bail in relation to applicant No. 1 K.K. Sharma.
2. Accordingly, this anticipatory bail application is dismissed as withdrawn in relation to applicant No. 1 K.K. Sharma.
3. This first application under Section 482 of The Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita has been filed on behalf of the applicants for grant of anticipatory bail.

4. Applicants No. 2 to 5 apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No. 158/2025 of Police Station-Omti, District-Jabalpur (MP) for commission of the offences punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420, 468, 469, 470, 472 of IPC and Section 316(5), 318(4), 336(3), 340(2), 341(2) and 61(2) of BNS has knocked the portal of this Court for grant of anticipatory NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37257 2 MCRC-31527-2025 bail.
5. Learned senior counsel for the applicants submits that applicants are not employee in the same office.
They are relatives of Sandeep Sharma.

It is urged that in applicant No. 2 Pushpa Sharma's K. K. Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2938226/
1 account, Rs. 3,44,837/-, Rahul's account Rs. 7,40,478/-, Kavita Sharma's account Rs. 11,12,190/-
and Anil Kumar Mishra's account Rs. 14,39,876/- were credited through RTGS and same were returned through RTGS.

entities.text: K. K. Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: No amount has been utilized by them.
Charge sheet has been filed against Sandeep Sharma and Swati Sharma.

It is also urged that case of present applicants are identical to that co-accused Swati Sharma and others, who have been released on bail by Coordinate bench of this court vide order dated 26.05.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 23444/2025.
On above grounds, it is urged that on the ground of parity, applicants be released on anticipatory bail.
6. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State fairly admitted that case of present applicants is identical to that of co-accused Swati Sharma and others.

7. Having regard to the factual matrix of the case as well as also having regard to the fact that case of present applicants is identical to that of co- accused Swati Sharma and others who have been released on bail, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicants may be released on bail.
Consequently, anticipatory bail application filed on behalf of applicants stands allowed.

8. It is directed that in the event of his arrest, applicants No. 2 to 5 be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:37257 3 MCRC-31527-2025 Fifteen Thousand Only) each with one solvent surety each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer.
It is also directed that the applicants shall abide by the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

It is made clear that applicants shall appear before the Investigating Officer as & when they are so directed and cooperate with the investigation and thhe shall also appear before the Trial Court failing which their bail shall automatically stand cancelled without further reference to the Court.
9. C.C. as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
